verdict.rationale: Versioning and deprecation policy is a fair axis for an SDK, but the evidence pack contains no documented API versioning scheme or deprecation policy. The only related item is a migration guide noting the rename from Claude Code SDK to Claude Agent SDK, which is a one-off migration note rather than a deprecation policy. Community complaints about billing-policy changes concern usage terms, not API versioning, so they are not relevant here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
